shared_elements: upright slab-shaped field with a framing border line
schematic human figure shown in profile/side view
band of repeated linear pattern along an edge
incised linear low-relief drawing with little interior modelling
main figural motif placed in the upper part of the field
justification: Both are upright framed panels with schematic incised profile human figures and a border strip of repeated pattern, and both place the main figural motif in the upper zone, which is about as generic as such correspondences get. Beyond that the content diverges completely: A shows two seated figures facing each other over an offering table above horizontal bands of sign-writing, while B shows a large fish-like creature above running spirals with a single tiny standing figure and no script at all.
